tocnf_intercalation.mechanism: TOCNF chains intercalate between MXene sheets, expanding the interlayer spacing
tocnf_intercalation.relation: Bragg: d(002) = lambda/(2 sin theta); intercalation raises d(002)
tocnf_intercalation.source: Cullity; Naguib et al., Adv. Mater. 26 (2014) 992 (MXene intercalation)

no_intercalation_mixing.mechanism: physical mixing without intercalation: MXene restacks with its own spacing
no_intercalation_mixing.relation: phase-separated blend: each phase keeps its d-spacing

hbond_network.mechanism: hydrogen bonds between TOCNF -OH/-COOH and MXene terminations
hbond_network.relation: H-bonding lowers the O-H stretching frequency (red shift)

no_interaction_blend.mechanism: no specific interfacial interaction: the spectrum is the superposition of the components
